items.title: SpaceX Declines 6%, Tesla Falls 5% as Democratic Sweep Raises Merger and Regulatory Risks; General Motors Rises 2%
items.summary: A Democratic sweep of Congress is hitting Elon Musk's companies in ways that have nothing to do with earnings, and legacy automakers are quietly benefiting as investors reassess who carries the political risk in a potential trillion-dollar merger.

items.title: Ross Perot Left IBM in 1962 and Started a Company With $1,000. In 1984, General Motors Bought It for $2.5 Billion
items.summary: IBM capped his commissions, so Ross Perot quit with a borrowed $1,000 and a pitch his former employer had already rejected. What he built from that rejection forced one of America's largest corporations to come to him decades later.
